g.text: J4: solder two wires from PDC004 OUT+ / OUT-. USB-C remains on PDC004.

g.desc: J4: solder two wires from PDC004 OUT+ / OUT-. USB-C remains on PDC004.

g.text: Module includes inductor/diode/feedback; PCB pads are wire interfaces only.

g.desc: Module includes inductor/diode/feedback; PCB pads are wire interfaces only.

g.text: 30 LEDs: budget 1.8A at 5V + ESP allowance up to 0.5A. Target 5V/2.5A.

g.desc: 30 LEDs: budget 1.8A at 5V + ESP allowance up to 0.5A. Target 5V/2.5A.

g.text: U3: wired module, not a bare MP1584 IC. Set output to 5.0V before connecting loads.

g.desc: U3: wired module, not a bare MP1584 IC. Set output to 5.0V before connecting loads.

g.text: Power rating is provisional: verify buck temperature/ripple in closed enclosure.

g.desc: Power rating is provisional: verify buck temperature/ripple in closed enclosure.

g.text: GPIO4 = LED data; GPIO5 = case button. Header pins share these functions.

g.desc: GPIO4 = LED data; GPIO5 = case button. Header pins share these functions.

g.text: UART is 3.3V TTL; PDC004 USB-C is POWER ONLY, no USB data/programming.
